card.text: Explore Callisto in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Voyager and Galileo imagery of Jupiter’s heavily cratered moon and its ancient surface.

introduction.text: Callisto is Jupiter’s outermost large moon. Bright impact craters cover its ancient icy surface, which may conceal a deep ocean.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Source detail ranges from 400 m to 60 km per pixel. Photographed shadows and seams remain; the gray grid marks missing data.

enhanced.title: Processed color mosaic
enhanced.summary: May 2001 Galileo color over about 29% of the globe. Gray grid: unseen or withheld. Processed display colors, not albedo.

infrared.title: Galileo NIMS spectral color
infrared.summary: Galileo NIMS observations assign red, green and blue to 0.77, 2.25 and 3.66 µm, following the archive guide. This false-color view shows spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. The observations have Minnaert photometric correction; resolution, residual brightness and seams vary. Fixed channel stretches clip extreme values. Gray grid marks areas lacking a valid sample in any selected band.
